items.title: Urgent Action Required Critical Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce (APSB26-146)
items.summary: A zero-day unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, dubbed StyleSmuggler) actively exploited in the wild, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-138
items.summary: A regularly scheduled security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Action Required: Critical Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce (APSB25-88)
items.summary: An issue (CVE-2025-54236) in Adobe Commerce where an attacker could take over customer accounts through the Commerce REST API.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-92
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe Security Bulletin APSB25-50
items.summary: A security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, which could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Adobe Security Bulletin APSB25-26
items.summary: A security update resolving important and moderate vulnerabilities, which could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie.
